blocks.title: 📰 1. 💰 ESI, FINANCE & BUSINESS NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 New EPFO Rules Mandate 3-Day Settlement Window with 12% Penal Interest on Delays. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Imposes strict 3-day turnaround time for provident fund withdrawal claims to eliminate administrative delays.
Settlement Window: EPFO mandated to settle PF withdrawal claims within 3 working days.
Penal Interest Penalty: Imposes 12% penal interest per annum on officials for claim delays exceeding 20 days.
Pension & Insurance Claims: Pension and EDLI insurance claims must be processed within 20 days.
Full Corpus Withdrawal Age: Lowers the age for full PF corpus withdrawal to 55 years (international workers 58 years).
3-day PF settlement window vs 20-day penal interest threshold.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on 8.25% annual interest rate, Central Board of Trustees (CBT) decision, and wage ceiling limit (₹15,000).
